title: Techno-Optimism
description: Technological progress is the primary driver of human flourishing and problem-solving

coreArchitecture.centralConcept: Technological progress is the primary driver of human flourishing and problem-solving
coreArchitecture.keyNarratives: Moore's Law, falling costs of goods, exponential innovation curves, previous technology pessimism proven wrong
coreArchitecture.invariantElements: Faith in human ingenuity, inevitability of progress, abundance through innovation
coreArchitecture.example: Norman Borlaug's Green Revolution saving a billion lives despite Malthusian predictions

transmissionMechanisms.primaryVectors: Tech success stories, startup culture, popular science communication, visible technological breakthroughs
transmissionMechanisms.requiredResources: Examples of transformative technologies, historical progress data
transmissionMechanisms.easeOfTransmission: High due to tangible benefits in everyday life
transmissionMechanisms.example: Smartphone evolution demonstrating continuous improvement and expanded capabilities

selectionDefense.environmentalFactors: Thrives in periods of visible technological advancement
selectionDefense.defenseMechanisms: Points to historical track record of pessimists being wrong
selectionDefense.competitiveAdvantages: Offers actionable hope versus defensive pessimism
selectionDefense.example: COVID vaccine development speed countering general pessimism about pandemic response

evolutionPattern.commonMutations: From mechanical to digital to AI/biotech optimism
evolutionPattern.adaptationCapabilities: Absorbs new fields (nanotech, space, longevity) while maintaining core thesis
evolutionPattern.stabilityVolatility: Progress narrative remains while specific technologies change
evolutionPattern.example: Evolution from "computers will augment humans" to "AI will augment humans" - same optimistic frame, new technology

socialNetworkEffects.feedbackLoops: Tech success creates wealth which funds more tech development
socialNetworkEffects.statusDynamics: Being seen as a creator/innovator rather than critic/pessimist
socialNetworkEffects.example: Silicon Valley's builder culture where technological solutions are the default answer

emotionalHooks.primaryEmotions: Wonder at possibilities, excitement about future, disdain for stagnation
emotionalHooks.rewardMechanisms: Seeing predictions come true, participating in progress
emotionalHooks.motivationStructures: Being part of humanity's ascent, solving grand challenges
emotionalHooks.example: SpaceX launches reigniting space age optimism and vision of multi-planetary humanity
